item.title: Jack Osbourne’s Family Tribute to Ozzy at the VMAs Draws Emotional Response From His Ex-Wife
item.description: When the MTV VMAs decided to honor Ozzy Osbourne after his death this July at age 76, his family was front and center. Jack Osbourne, joined by his four daughters, introduced a performance dedicated to the Black Sabbath icon.

item.title: JACK OSBOURNE Slams ROGER WATERS Over OZZY: 'My Father Always Thought You Were a C@#$%'
item.description: Jack Osbourne did not tiptoe after Roger Waters said he never cared about Black Sabbath and “couldn’t give a f@#$%” about Ozzy Osbourne, Jack answered with a blunt message of his own.

item.title: Slipknot, Lamb of God, Anthrax Members Join Comic Con Birmingham Lineup
item.description: Comic Con is coming to Birmingham, and this year’s event will feature more than just movie and TV stars. Several well-known rock and metal musicians are set to appear, including members of Slipknot, Lamb of God, and Anthrax.
